'''Allion Vlenda''' was an employee of [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Vlenda announced the decision to increase the company's [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] marketability and make it available to the wider public.
